verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Bolt connecting outward to GitHub/MCP servers as a client (e.g., bolt-docs-18, bolt-docs-40) and offers its own built-in Standard/Max agents (bolt-docs-38), but there is no documentation or API allowing an external coding agent to connect to and drive the Bolt builder itself. Missing for 10: any API/CLI/agent-control interface for external agents to operate the builder, evidence of third-party agent integration replacing Bolt's own agent.
